children: SUNSTONE DEVELOPMENT ESTABLISHES AN ANODE PRODUCTION FACILITY IN UAE- STATEMENT
PROJECT IS EXPECTED TO GENERATE SKILLED EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITIES- STATEMENT
UAE'S MINISTRY OF INVESTMENT - SIGNS MOU WITH SUNSTONE DEVELOPMENT TO SUPPORT ESTABLISHMENT OF AN ANODE PRODUCTION FACILITY IN UAE
UAE'S MINISTRY OF INVESTMENT - AS PART OF MOU, MINISTRY OF INVESTMENT WILL SUPPORT SUNSTONE'S ESTABLISHMENT AND LICENSING IN THE UAE
UAE'S MINISTRY OF INVESTMENT - FACILITY WILL REDUCE RELIANCE ON IMPORTED ANODES
UAE'S MINISTRY OF INVESTMENT - TO OVERSEE DELIVERY, THE MINISTRY AND SUNSTONE WILL ESTABLISH A JOINT WORKING GROUP CHAIRED BY THE MINISTRY
UAE'S MINISTRY OF INVESTMENT - FACILITY WILL REDUCE RELIANCE ON IMPORTED ANODES, SUPPORT COMPETITIVENESS OF UAE'S WIDER ALUMINIUM INDUSTRY
